newsitem.title: SPAIN: Montoro sees Spain CPI under 3.4 pct by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Montoro sees Spain CPI under 3.4 pct by year-end.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Thursday that inflation is likely to end 1996 below the government's 3.4-percent target.

"The fall (in the CPI) in October helps to confirm the achievement of the government's target. It's almost certain now that the CPI will end December below 3.4 percent, confirming the credibility of the 1997 target," Montoro told journalists while in parliament.
The government's inflation target for 1997 is 2.6 percent.
